text: This solution, Fourth Disaster Risk Management Development Policy Loan with a Catastrophe‑Deferred Drawdown Option (CAT‑DDO 4) addresses natural catastrophe in Republic of the Philippines between Government of the Republic of the Philippines, International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD), and World Bank. The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
